notes.title: Equilibrious Test Conclusion Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Soul Tamers,


The Equilibrious Test for Perfect New World has officially ended.

We extend our sincere appreciation to all participants of the Equilibrious Closed Beta Test for Perfect New World. Your overwhelming support and enthusiasm witnessed during this testing phase have been truly heartening.

Your voices mean a lot to us, the abundance of feedback generously shared by you is invaluable. Your insights and suggestions have become guiding lights, illuminating the path for enhancing gameplay and refining the overall experience.

Please stay closely connected with us on our social media platforms to stay up-to-date on the latest news and announcements. We wholeheartedly invite each Soul Tamer to persist in sharing feedback and suggestions through our Discord channel or our support email, [b]helppnwonline@gmail.com[/b]. Your continued involvement is the very essence of our game's growth and refinement.

Once again, our heartfelt thanks for your dedicated participation and unwavering support during the Equilibrious Test. We eagerly anticipate reuniting with you in the next testing phase, enriched with new optimizations and thrilling features.


- Perfect New World Game Team

notes.title: Equilibrious Test Recruitment
notes.content:
Dear Soul Tamer,


After a long wait, Perfect New World is gearing up for the [[b]Equilibrious Test[/b]]! 
This wouldn't have been possible without your unwavering patience and support. 


We extend our heartfelt gratitude for your dedication and enthusiasm. As we venture into this fresh journey filled with fantasy, we invite you to join us as a Soul Tamer. Your feedback on the game is invaluable to us, as we've packed it with exciting new content just waiting for you to explore.


[b]✦ Sign-Up Period ✦[/b]

Start: October 11, 2023, at 23:00 EDT	
End: November 7, 2023, at 23:59 EDT


[b]✦ About the Test ✦[/b]

Type: Limited participants. No sign-up fee is required. Your game data will [b]NOT[/b] carry over to future tests or the live game.
Platform: Official Website
[url=https://pnw.perfectworld.com/][b]>>>Click Here to the official website<<<[/b][/url]


[b]✦ Eligibility and Notification ✦[/b]

1. Click the link below to fill out and submit a questionnaire. Make sure you fill in the correct information.
2. Once the sign-up period is over, we will invite some of the eligible Soul Tamers to join our test via mail.


[b]✦ How to Receive the Eligibility ✦[/b]

1. Questionnaire: Complete the questionnaire and await the results.
[url=https://pnw.perfectworld.com/net/230926recruit/survey/index.html][b]>>>Click Here for the Questionnaire<<<[/b][/url]

2. Luck Challenge: Participate in the "Spin to Win!" Lucky wheel event, where you can win a pass for the Equilibrious Test or increase your chances of obtaining it by spinning the lucky wheel daily.
[url=https://pnw.perfectworld.com/net/230926recruit/index.html][b]>>>Go to the Official Website to participate in the event<<<[/b][/url]
Completing the questionnaire increases your chances of receiving a testing qualification. Please make sure to remember the account you used to participate in the event, as it will be used to sign in to the game after the test starts.


[b]✦ How to Join with Friends ✦[/b]

When you complete the questionnaire, make sure to share/enter the invitation code from your friend. This way, you and all your friends will have an opportunity to embark on the journey to Perfect New World together.


[b]✦ Notes ✦[/b]
1. All in-game content in this test is still in development. It does not represent the final content.
2. Your eligibility is only good for this test. After this test is over, all your game data will be deleted.
3. Make sure to fill in the correct information when taking the survey, so you can be invited to the test.
4. You are not allowed to share or sell your activation code or your test account. If you do, we have the right to cancel your test eligibility. Make sure to secure your account information to prevent unnecessary losses.

notes.title: A Letter to The Soul Tamers of Perfect New World
notes.content:
Dear Soul Tamer,


The first Exploratory Closed Beta Test of Perfect New World has concluded. Thank you for submitting your precious feedback. We will review your comments carefully and take them seriously as we develop our games. Next, we would like to share with you some of the optimization plans we have for Perfect New World in the future.


[b]1. Adding more gameplay for the World Map[/b]

We will further expand the World Map gameplay content and add more exploration details and interactive elements to not just enrich map gameplay and environment elements but create a more realistic, dynamic in-game world.

[b]2. Adding map tiles of different styles[/b]

We will add map tiles of various styles and themes in the future, each showcasing unique scenes, buildings, and cultural features, allowing you to immerse in a diverse, colorful world.

[b]3. Adding more Class types[/b]

We will work hard to improve the controls of this game, allowing you to control your character's movements and skills more easily. Meanwhile, we'll add more new Classes as additional options for you to choose from.

[b]4. Adding Fair PvP mode[/b]

Considering the need of our players, we will add Fair PvP mode so players can duke it out and see who is better. Meanwhile, we plan to introduce a multiplayer battleground that offers new modes, with each mode having unique in-game objectives and challenges.

[b]5. Improving combat satisfaction and smoothness[/b]

We'll optimize the combat system to create a combat experience that is smoother and more satisfying.

[b]6. Telling an exciting story through Story Missions[/b]

In the future, we'll tell a more exciting story through our Story Missions and add more side quests for you to explore extra storylines, diverse character interactions, and additional lore about this world. We hope this will deepen the emotional impact and significance of the game, enhancing player immersion.

[b]7. Adding diverse features to gear system[/b]

In the future, we'll provide a more diverse gear system, with each weapon having its own features. Also, by combining the right stats and features, you can create your own builds of Weapons, Spirit Beasts, and Talents, showcasing your unique combat style.

[b]8. Optimizing the frame rates[/b]

We'll continue to optimize the game performance to improve frame rates and smoothness, ensuring the game can run smoothly, no matter the hardware configuration.

[b]9. Adding more social content[/b]

In the future, we plan to add more social, interactive features and events so players can more easily make friends and work together. In doing so, we hope to encourage communication among players and the formation of a vibrant community.

[b]10. Adding more characteristics to storyline NPCs[/b]

We'll add more characteristics and exciting origin stories to the storyline NPCs. By telling more details and adding more interactive options, the NPCs will become more lively and interesting. This will also encourage our players to progress the storyline.

[b]11. Creating an option for you to skip storylines[/b]

To meet the need of different players, we'll include an option that allows you to skip storylines. You can choose not to watch through the storylines if you prefer not to, which gives back control to our players.

[b]12. Improving character customization[/b]

We plan to add more abundant experience in character customization in the future.


Before the next test begins, we will work hard to enrich and improve our gameplay content based on your feedback. We hope to provide a better gaming experience, and from the bottom of our hearts, we thank you for following and supporting us. It is you who give us the momentum to keep on improving and create a better Perfect New World. We hope to see you in our next test.


- Perfect New World Game Team

notes.title: "Perfect New World" Exploratory CBT Period and Eligibility Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Soul Tamer,

The amount of feedback and suggestions that Perfect New World has received since it was uploaded on Steam and during the [b]Exploratory Closed Beta Test[/b] recruitment period has far exceeded our expectations. We know you have been eagerly awaiting this game and would like to sincerely thank you for your support!

Get ready to begin a new adventure in a unique Eastern fantasy world! The test officially starts at [b]7:00 a.m. EDT on May 4th, 2023[/b]. Please note that this test is only open to limited participants, and your game data will not carry over to future tests or the live game.

[b]Exploratory Closed Beta Test eligibility will be released consecutively.[/b] Please check that the email address provided in the recruitment questionnaire is correct as we will be notifying selected Soul Tamers via [Email]. Please note that only emails notifying official "Exploratory Closed Beta Test" eligibility will be honored.

For Soul Tamers who did not enter a valid Steam ID, we will contact you via email. Please follow the instructions in the email to update your information with us. We may then issue additional test eligibility depending on the needs of the test.

Note: Please check your [Trash] and [Subscribed] folders if you do not see our email in your inbox, as you may have auto-filter on.

For Soul Tamers who were not selected this time, fret not, for there will be additional rounds of testing with more extensive gameplay content and a smoother, more optimized experience in the future, so subscribe for subsequent official notifications.

Thank you, Soul Tamers, for your continued support! We look forward to seeing you in Perfect New World!


✦Notes✦
1. This is the first small-scale, closed beta test of "Perfect New World". All test content is still in development and is not representative of the final game quality.
2. Test eligibility only applies to this test. All game data will be deleted after the test.
3. Sharing or trading activation codes and test accounts is strictly prohibited. Offenders will have their test eligibility removed. Please keep your personal account information and virtual assets safe.
4. Soul Tamers outside the region of North America may experience disconnections and lags during the game. We sincerely apologize if this has caused an unfavorable experience for you.
5. This is a closed beta test. Please do not publish game content on social media platforms using screenshots, screen recordings, livestreams, etc.

✦To Learn More✦

Discord: https://discord.gg/3q5Ueb7Z4c
